findings.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via URLField in Admin
findings.description: The diff removes the URL validation logic that was specifically designed to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks via dangerous URL schemes (e.g., `javascript:`, `data:`) stored in `URLField` values. By reverting to rendering the raw value directly into an `<a href>` tag without validation, the application reintroduces a stored XSS vulnerability. An attacker who can control the `URLField` value (via form input or API) can inject malicious JavaScript that will execute in an admin's browser when they view the changelist or object detail page.
